newsitem.title: USA: RSI sees lower manufacturing costs.
newsitem.headline: RSI sees lower manufacturing costs.

text.p: RSI Inc, which develops full-motion video and audio communications, said a planned change by a new contract manufacturer is expected to lead to significantly lower product costs once manufacturing begins at the new site in the first quarter of calendar 1997.

Earlier on Monday, the company posted a September 30 first-quarter loss of $0.37 compared to a year-ago loss of $0.24 per share. Average shares rose to 3.3 million from 2.8 million. Effective September 30, it sold 1.5 million shares of common stock through a private offering, netting about $4 million.
